name: On D Go by Modge | Artisanal Desserts & Specialty Coffee
description: On D Go by Modge (অন ডি গো বাই মধ্যে) — A modern dessert atelier and specialty coffee destination in Sector V, Kolkata. Indulge in artisanal tiramisu, signature Matilda cakes, handcrafted cheesecakes, and slow-brewed coffee.
